preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 1000.
The number of letters in the English alphabet up to which characters in s are allowed is between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: s is a string of length n consisting of small English letters
preconditions.description: The string s consists of characters from the English alphabet up to the p-th letter.

preconditions.expression: s does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more
preconditions.description: The string s does not contain any palindrome contiguous substring of length 2 or more.

postconditions.expression: output is either a string of length n consisting of small English letters or the string 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is the lexicographically next tolerable string of the same length as the input string s, or 'NO' if no such string exists.
